description: Launch a fixed-supply NFT collection on the MomoSwap NFT launchpad. Every image in `artDir` (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, natural file-name order, optional Metaplex-style `<name>.json` beside each for name + traits) becomes one item. The art is uploaded to IPFS, the order is sealed behind a fairness commitment MomoSwap holds the seed for (so the creator cannot know which mint gets which piece), and the art stays hidden until the sale ends. Price: `startPriceCook` is the first item's all-in price; the curve ends near `curveMultiple`× that. At graduation `floorLockPct` of the raise becomes a permanent floor and the creator gets the rest. A launch is FINAL — the art, order, curve and royalty can never change — so run with `dryRun: true` first and confirm the preview (prices, raise, floor) with the user. Reads local files: refused on a hosted server. Signs a login message with the wallet (no fee), then the create transaction (rent only, ~0.03 COOK; there is no creation fee). Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

allowlist.description: wallets that may mint first, during the allowlist phase

allowlistHours.description: length of the allowlist phase in hours (default 1)

antiSnipe.description: limit each wallet during the opening minutes (default true)

artDir.description: folder on this machine holding the art (2–10,000 images, max 25 MB each), inside the home directory or COOKIE_IMAGE_DIR, no hidden folders

curveMultiple.description: last item's price ÷ first (default 4; the site offers 2, 4 and 9)

dryRun.description: validate the art and preview the curve, raise and floor without uploading or signing

durationHours.description: how long minting stays open, at most 720 (30 days, the program's cap) (default 24); a drop that does not graduate by then refunds holders

floorLockPct.description: share of the raise locked forever as the floor at graduation, % (default 20)

graduationTargetPct.description: graduate once the raise reaches this % of the sell-out raise; the remaining items then mint at random by request (default 100 = graduate at sell-out)

imagePath.description: collection image file (defaults to the first piece of art)

launchAt.description: ISO date-time to open minting, up to 30 days ahead (default now)

placeholderPath.description: image collectors see before the reveal (defaults to the collection image)

royaltyPartner.description: optional plain wallet (not a program or token account) that shares the creator's royalty and proceeds

royaltyPct.description: creator royalty on secondary sales, % (default 5; capped by the launchpad)

startPriceCook.description: the first item's price in COOK, trade fee included

name: create_nft_drop
title: Launch an NFT drop
